text: The DAO form is established but not yet an institution: total assets under DAO governance have crossed the hundred-billion-dollar threshold, yet the institutional architecture the form requires remains incomplete.
citation: Wulf A. Kaal, The Institutional Deficit in Decentralized Autonomous Organizations - An Empirical Analysis (2026). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=6819121

abstract: The form is no longer an experiment. It is also not yet an institution. That is the gap this Article documents.
